title: Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1: Recommendations for Mitigating the Risk of Software Vulnerabilities
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
versionOrDate: NIST SP 800-218 Version 1.1 final, February 2022; reviewed 2026-08-02
relevance: Primary NIST framework used to place pipeline controls inside a broader secure-development system: protect development environments, preserve release integrity, produce and retain evidence, respond to vulnerabilities and address root causes.
